items: A flat monthly rate based on your plan, with unlimited users. We give you the exact price once we've seen your business and the modules you need.
Do I need to buy equipment?
No. It runs in the browser of the phone, tablet or computer you already have. For the kitchen, the bar or the TV, any screen with a browser will do.
Will you help me move my data?
Yes. We help you load your menu or products, your inventory and your team, and we train your people so they get started without a hitch.
Does it work on a phone?
Yes. It opens in the phone's browser, nothing to install. Your customers also order from their own phone with the table's QR code.
Your information is stored in the cloud and travels encrypted. Each person signs in with their own user or PIN and sees only what they need. And if you ask, we delete your data.
What if the internet goes down?
Clonexa runs in the cloud, so it needs a connection. Everything you've already logged stays saved; if your venue's Wi-Fi drops, you can keep going on mobile data.
Can you build a system that isn't on this page?
Yes. Clonexa is built from modules. If your operation does it, we design it with you and build it in stages, connected to what you already have.
Ready-made solutions are up and running in days. Custom development is delivered in stages so you can start using it early.
It's in development and coming soon.

restaurantes.name: Restaurants
restaurantes.title: Restaurants | Clonexa
restaurantes.description: Restaurant system: QR ordering and orders from the server's phone, kitchen display, POS, end-of-day close, inventory and reports. Book your demo.
restaurantes.h1: Restaurant system: orders, kitchen and POS connected
intro: In a busy restaurant, every order goes through many hands. The guest tells the server, the server writes it on a ticket, the kitchen deciphers the handwriting and, in the end, the cashier puts the bill together from memory. At every step a dish can get lost, a table can be undercharged or left waiting. At closing time, balancing the register and knowing what sold takes time nobody has.

Clonexa connects that whole journey in one system. Guests can order from the QR code on their table, or the server takes the order on their phone. The kitchen gets it instantly on a screen organized in columns, with a timer on every ticket, together with delivery orders. The cashier finds each table's bill already built and charges cash, transfer or card. At the end of the day, the register close shows what was sold and what came in by each payment method.

You don't need to buy special equipment: it runs on the phones, tablets and computers you already have. We set it up with your menu, your tables, your brand and your colors, and we stay with you while your team learns to use it.
restaurantes.fit: It works for sit-down restaurants, fast food, cafés and businesses with delivery, whether they have one location or several. If your restaurant works in a particular way, we adapt the modules to your process.
steps: Guests order from the table's QR code
They scan the code with their phone and see your dishes on video, from the front and from the side, with their prices; they build their order and confirm it. No app to download.
The server takes the order on their phone
They pick the category, tap the dish and send it to the kitchen. No more paper tickets and handwriting nobody can read.
The kitchen gets it instantly
Every ticket lands on the kitchen screen in the New order column, moves to Cooking and then to Ready, with how long each one has taken. Delivery orders arrive on the same screen.
The register charges the exact bill
The table's bill already has everything that was ordered. Charge cash, transfer or card without adding things up by hand.
End-of-day close with no gaps
When you finish, the register close shows total sales, items, paid orders and how much came in by each payment method.

No. Clonexa runs in the browser of the phones, tablets and computers you already have. If you want a screen for the kitchen, any tablet or TV with a browser will do.
Do my guests have to download an app to order by QR?
No. Scanning the table's QR code opens the menu in the phone's browser, and from there they build and confirm their order.

Electronic invoicing is in development and coming soon. In the meantime, Clonexa handles your orders, your register, your inventory and your reports.
How long until it's up and running?
Ready-made restaurant solutions are up and running in days: we set up your menu, your tables and your brand, and we train your team.

bares.h1: Bar system: QR ordering, bar display and live games
intro: In a packed bar, servers can't keep up, orders get shouted over the music and the bar loses track of which table ordered what. At the end of the night you have to rebuild the tabs, and since closing comes after midnight, sales end up split across two dates and the numbers don't add up.

Clonexa brings order to the night. Every table has its own QR code: guests see the menu, order from their phone, check the table's tab and even request the song they want to hear. The bar sees every order on a screen, from pending to delivered, and the register charges each table's exact tab. Closing is done by business day, so whatever you sell after midnight stays in the same night.

To keep people around and coming back, Clonexa has live games: guests play from their phone and the leaderboard shows up on the bar's TV, along with the round's prize. Everything runs on the equipment you already have, with your brand and your colors.
bares.fit: It works for bars, gastropubs, nightclubs and nightlife venues that serve both at tables and at the bar, and want faster orders, clear tabs and guests who stay longer. If your bar has its own dynamic, like events or special rounds, we tailor it for you.

talleres-y-fabricas.description: System for workshops and factories: workshop board with PIN, time per style, production by batch and hourly payroll. Book your Clonexa demo.
talleres-y-fabricas.h1: System for workshops and factories: time, production and payroll
intro: In a garment workshop or a small factory, knowing who worked on what and how long it took usually depends on paper timesheets. At the end of the pay period someone spends hours adding up shifts, overtime and breaks to calculate payroll, and nobody knows for sure how much each piece costs to make or how each batch is going.

Clonexa puts a tablet in the workshop. Each person clocks in with their PIN, picks the style they're going to work on and starts their shift; if they take a break, the system logs it. With that, the production board shows finished pieces, the progress of each batch, how many days each one has taken and the labor cost per piece, without anyone typing data by hand.

Those same hours flow into payroll: regular hours, overtime and the total to pay for the period, with every shift detailed per person. And from what was produced you can generate quotes and invoices for your customers.
talleres-y-fabricas.fit: It works for garment workshops, contract shops that produce for brands, small factories and any operation that produces by style or batch and pays by time worked. The owner sees in one place how much the workshop produces, how much the labor for each piece costs and how much is owed for the pay period, without waiting for someone to finish adding up timesheets. If your process has its own steps, like quality control or partial deliveries to the customer, we build them to measure on the same foundation.

call-centers.title: Call centers | Clonexa
call-centers.description: System for call centers that sell services: live agents, calls and results, quotes and tickets, contracts and finance. Book your demo.
call-centers.h1: Call center system: agents, quotes and finance connected
intro: When a call center sells services, information usually ends up scattered: calls on a spreadsheet, quotes in loose documents, approved services somewhere else and payments in accounting. The supervisor doesn't know in real time what each agent is doing, and finance finds out late about what needs to be collected.

Clonexa brings the whole operation into one system. The supervisor sees every agent with their status (on a call, available or on break), how many calls they've made, how many quotes and tickets came out of them and how long they last. When a customer asks for a price, the quote is created in the system; if they approve it, it becomes a ticket or service order, gets scheduled and is tracked until it's fulfilled.

Finance reviews tickets before invoicing and sees what's ready to collect, the available credit on each contract and the invoices coming due. That way sales, operations and money speak the same language. It's a solution we build to fit each operation, on top of Clonexa.
call-centers.fit: It works for companies that take calls and sell services by phone that then need to be scheduled and collected: special transportation, tourism, events and business services, among others. We roll it out in stages: first agent supervision and call logging, then quotes and tickets, and then finance and contracts. That way your team starts using it quickly and each stage is tested with the real operation before moving to the next one.

personal-en-campo.description: System for field teams: shift start with location, breaks, work zones and material requests with numbered orders. Book your Clonexa demo.
personal-en-campo.h1: System for field teams: shifts, location and materials
intro: When your team works outside the office, on construction sites, installations or setups, it's hard to know what time each person started, whether they're in the right place and what materials they took. Hours are reported by chat, breaks aren't logged and materials leave the warehouse without a clear order, so in the end nobody knows where they went.

With Clonexa, every technician starts their shift from their phone and the system logs the time and whether they're inside their work zone. The supervisor sees live who's active, who's on break and how long each person has been at it, without calling anyone.

When the team needs materials, they request them in the system and a numbered order is created. The warehouse approves and delivers it, and on delivery it's deducted from inventory; if the material comes back, the return is logged against that same order. The hours worked are ready for payroll.
personal-en-campo.fit: It works for companies in installations, assembly, construction, maintenance, networks, security and any operation with technicians or crews working outside the office. The supervisor stops calling people one by one to find out where they are, the warehouse knows what materials went out and for which job, and the back office receives the hours worked without having to rebuild them from chats. We set it up with your work zones, your materials and your team, and we expand it in stages based on what your operation needs.
steps: Shift start with location

The supervisor sees active and on-break team members, each person's time and whether they're inside their work zone. If someone is on break you can see for how long, and when the shift ends the hours are logged for payroll.
Material requests with a numbered order
Every material request becomes a numbered order showing who requested it, the quantity, the destination and its status: pending, approved, delivered or returned.
